name: comfort
description: Being within a tolerable zone of physical, social, or mental discomfort.

variations.name: temporary comfort
variations.description: If you're aware that the current calm conditions are not going to last, you may have a sense of gratitude and desire to fully experience the present moment.

variations.name: social comfort
variations.description: The feeling that you're amongst people who accept an important part of your identity.

variations.name: physical comfort
variations.description: The recognition that your body is not experiencing significant discomfort.

commentaries.quote: 'Comfort' is relative. We're never truly without some kind of discomfort for long, but some people have higher tolerances physical or social discomfort.
You can be physically comfortable while being mentally uncomfortable or vice versa. In fact, for many of us in the modern world, they're almost always out of sync by definition.
You'll probably only recognize the relief of comfort for a short while after the discomfort.

conditions: Self perceives that being amongst a certain social group is less stressful.
Perception that the body is experiencing no more than minor discomfort.
